note: Per-symbology sizes for tool 5. X = narrowest bar or module, mm. Quiet zones in X. EAN/UPC are sized by magnification of a nominal X; the others by X directly.

contrast.source: ISO/IEC 15416 symbol contrast grades (A >= 70%, B >= 55%, C >= 40%, D >= 20%); verified with red light (about 660 nm)
contrast.note: 660 nm verified in the GSCN; grade thresholds from a verifier vendor manual (secondary) until ISO/IEC 15416 is read.

upca.label: UPC-A
upca.use: Retail products scanned at a US or Canadian checkout
upca.source: GS1 General Specifications v23, EAN/UPC dimensions (GS1 Austria edition, figs 5.2.6.6-1 to -4, 5.2.6.7-1)

upce.label: UPC-E
upce.source: GS1 General Specifications v23, EAN/UPC dimensions (GS1 Austria edition, figs 5.2.6.6-1 to -4, 5.2.6.7-1)

ean13.label: EAN-13
ean13.use: Retail products outside the US and Canada (also scans in the US)
ean13.source: GS1 General Specifications v23, EAN/UPC dimensions (GS1 Austria edition, figs 5.2.6.6-1 to -4, 5.2.6.7-1)

ean8.label: EAN-8

itf14.label: ITF-14

itf14.source: GS1 General Specifications change notice GSCN 16-434 (symbol specification tables 2 and 5); bearer bar 4.8 mm: GS1 Sweden, Use ITF-14
itf14.note: Values read in the 2016 GS1 change notice; current GenSpecs table 5.12.3 not yet read. X below 0.635 mm should not be plate-printed on corrugated.

gs1-128.label: GS1-128

gs1-128.note: Max X 0.940 mm for logistic labels (table 5; trade items allow 1.016). 2016 text; current table not yet read.
